title: UL-12 — Challenge: Step Functions
scenario: Extend Step Functions with failure, Retry, and Catch handling.
acceptanceCriteria: State machine includes intentional failure branch.
Retry policy configured on task state.
Catch block routes failure to cleanup Pass state.
Successful path still reachable with valid input.
Execution history shows retry attempt count.
IAM role scoped to Lambda or mock task only.
CloudWatch logs not required but if enabled, removed in teardown.
Teardown deletes state machine before role.
stopChargesPanel: Delete state machine and IAM role for ul-12.

verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-12 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-12 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=ul-12 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-12. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.
